result.title: Sequential Learning-Based Physics-Informed Neural Network Modeling for Parameter Estimation on a Power Converter
result.summary: A staged physics-informed neural network (PINN) is proposed for identifying the inductance, capacitance and parasitic resistances of a DC buck converter from time-domain data. Gradients are released in the order of L to C to rL to rC, a sequence derived from sensitivity analysis. The five-stage schedule recovers L and C to within 5% and the series ESR to 10%, while a three-stage variant attains the same accuracy 11% faster. An 84 factorial sweep confirms that the trained PINN remains accurate for simultaneous 8% perturbations of all four components, achieving a waveform RMSE of 2.6 x 10-2 over 5 ms-an order-of-magnitude better than a simultaneous-training baseline.

AI.brief_summary: 提出分阶段训练的 PINN，按灵敏度分析确定 L→C→rL→rC 的梯度释放顺序，从时域数据辨识 DC buck 变换器的电感、电容与寄生电阻；五阶段方案 L、C 误差在 5% 内、串联 ESR 在 10% 内，三阶段变体精度相当而快 11%。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「按灵敏度排序的分阶段梯度释放」可能为 LVR 中的训练阶段划分与监督/贡献分配提供线索，但该文属电力电子参数辨识的远领域应用，无内部推理状态或视觉证据，迁移价值需核查。
